limitations: The two policies each succeed3/4, but on different cases: TopK loses61400 and full loses61402. With4 paired configurations and one target draw each, equal aggregate counts do not establish equivalence or noninferiority. The published paired bootstrap success-difference interval is [-0.75,0.75].

TopK always ran before full within each of4 parallel case workers. Times are measured under this declared scheduling/resource load; order and changing contention were not counterbalanced, so they are not isolated single-process microbenchmarks.
Mean paired decision ratio2.3394 differs from ratio of decision means2.3098; report which aggregation is used. Neither is the theoretical N/K ratio3.

Model-cold times include measured ValueScorer initialization only. Python/Torch import and worker/process startup remain separate; this is not a complete fresh-process startup measurement. Offline LLM proxy generation and training/collection are also excluded.

Independent target objects and nuisance draws share MuJoCo engine/geometry and known friction/gain bounds. These experiments do not establish hardware transfer, robust success probability, or sliding-stroke functionality.
Physical failure contrasts do not isolate friction/gain as causal variables. No reranking, tuning, replay, or physics execution was performed for this audit.
